record.name: Martial Artist
record.description: Bounty Hunter Martial Artists rely on disciplined unarmed combat, control techniques, and close-quarters prowess to subdue targets swiftly and efficiently.

progression_tree.description: Gain proficiency in Intimidation, Perception, and Persuasion.

effects.notes: The Bounty Hunter's inner balance shifts as they land a hit, granting proficiency in Intimidation, Perception, and Persuasion skills for the remainder of the turn.

progression_tree.description: Deal an additional 1d4 damage with unarmed strikes.

effects.notes: As your martial arts mastery reaches its peak, you channel the energy of your opponent's impact into a precise counterattack. Deal an additional 1d4 damage with unarmed strikes.

progression_tree.description: Gain expertise in one type of grapple or grappling technique.

effects.notes: With a swift and deadly motion, the bounty hunter's fingers wrap around their opponent's wrist or ankle, momentarily stunning them with the sudden grasp.

progression_tree.description: You can use your action to make a Wisdom (Insight) check against a creature's Wisdom saving throw.

effects.notes: Your eyes lock onto your foe, and with a swift mental jab, you discern their intentions. Make a Wisdom (Insight) check against the creature's Wisdom saving throw to uncover hidden information or anticipate their next move.

progression_tree.description: Gain proficiency in finesse melee attacks.

effects.notes: As a burst of focused energy, your unarmed strikes become precision tools. You gain proficiency in finesse melee attacks, weaving together the intricacies of combat with the elegance of art.

progression_tree.description: You can use your bonus action to make an unarmed attack with advantage.

effects.notes: With a swift, economical strike, you can use your bonus action to unleash a devastating combination of unarmed attacks with advantage against a foe that has just attacked you.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Assuming a defensive stance with legs spread wide, hands clasped behind back and eyes scanning the horizon for potential threats.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: A faint hum of blue Force energy emanates from the individual's fingertips, as if they are channeling their ki to enhance their physical prowess.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: A lone Bounty Hunter Martial Artist stands atop a dusty desert planet's rocky outcropping, gazing out at the twin suns setting over the horizon with a mixture of determination and trepidation in their expression.
contextual_modifiers: High-contrast color palette to emphasize texture and lighting
Dynamic pose with subtle motion blur to convey a sense of movement
